Page 13 Cont.
Jan. 7 Mrs. Mary Morissette - methodist - 41 - married and praying for family 13 yrs - seemingly all in vain.
Edgar M. Walsh - 41 - mental break ...
8 Millie Ruane - 40 -
Geo. D'Huyvetter - 61 - without faith in God or anything Superna- tural - believed to have cancer, yet refuses to have doctor: threatens to kill his wife .... as actually his brother killed his . . . and then himself.
Page 14
Jan. 8 Mary Jane Krentler - 22 - fell about 4 yrs ago and has had a weak back ever since. Scientifically there seems to be very little hope. She promises more frequent Com.
9 Mrs. Mary Mulligan - 72 - tongue - cnacer operation set for next Tuesday 13th enrolled Today.
Rev. Francis Carroll - 52 - dropped dead on 23rd anniv. of His or- dination ... This happened at Mid-night Mass in Dowagiae, Michigan. Having preached the sermon and intoned the Credo sat down .... Just as the Choir finished instead of rising and going to the Altar, just put his hand to his heart and lay over dead. - the Gregorian Masses - asks prayers too. R.I.P
Joseph A. Bellomo - 5 mo. - water on brain Dr. give no - mother convert - lost first two babies. Seemingly both have been remise - no sacraments for a long time ... promise to do better.
Mr. & Mrs. Joseph Bellk - young middle aged couple - neglecting religion are becoming dispondent, etc
Arleen Newbert - 17 - T.B. in Kiefer now about 12 mo. - Enrolled To-day
Page 15 Jan. 15 Mr. & Mrs. Carl J. Beckley - 29 - both praying for a family near 7 yrs. Ask for prayers that God bless them in this regard. Enrolled To-night for that intention.
Patricia LaForest - 5 months - 8'2 lbs-at birth 7% - Drs puzzled. ... Enrolled Today. Parents promise more frequent Communion.
